text: Tower, Air Canada 503. We are coming back due to burst tire during gear retraction. Luckily, it didn't burst in the well, but the starboard flaps seem to have been damaged. Air Canada 503. Are you able to manage a flaps up landing? Affirm. Can we use runway 22? It's longer. Air Canada 503 is cleared to land runway 22. Question. What is wrong with Air Canada 503?
